post.caption:
A rocket does not push on the air. It throws mass backwards and the exhaust pushes the rocket forwards, which is Newton's third law and nothing more. Stand on a skateboard and throw something heavy and you get the same effect. Air only adds drag and squeezes the exhaust plume inward, which is why upper-stage engines have far larger, more efficient nozzles. A rocket brings the thing it pushes against with it.
